name: get_device_family
description: Returns a device's real protocol family as one of these exact strings: "INSTEON", "Z-Wave", "Zigbee", "Matter", "Legacy Z-Wave", "Plugin", or "Unknown family". When another tool takes a `protocol` argument (pair_device, diagnostics_not_responding, diagnostics_no_status_feedback), map it to lowercase with no hyphen: INSTEON -> insteon, Z-Wave -> zwave, Zigbee -> zigbee, Matter -> matter. Legacy Z-Wave and Plugin devices have no pairing/diagnostics protocol (see pair_device and node_op for their removal flows). Never infer a device's family from its name, address/id, icon, or a naming convention you believe you've noticed -- always call this instead. Required before any protocol-specific diagnostics or action. Cheap and side-effect-free -- call it any time this fact is needed, not just while troubleshooting. One device per call -- call it once per device.

device_id.description: The device's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed.
